flags.title: ground: about 64 m2 inside the walls has no floor
flags.detail: 1 area inside the walls, the largest 64 m2, has no floor plate. The floor plate is made of the rooms the walls close (the bank's rule): where the walls or the facade do not close (gaps at corners, glass that is not built, or walls on a layer that is not built), the rooms between them get no floor and cannot be walked. Check the wall and glass layers on the Layers step; plates from the wall network are a later option.
